title: abyss of terror
description: This mod will add more than 10 entities and several horror dimensions to your game world.
body:
Hello, this is my **first** mod, I made it alone, maybe still in beta, hope you can help point out errors and bugs. _The mod _**supports**_ multiplayer_

**Description**:
The Abyss of Terror mod is a horror mod with multiple dimensions and a host of strange creatures that can attack you at any moment. The mod also adds some suspenseful ambient music.
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

This mod differs from others thanks to the AI of the monsters, who are not afraid of water or boats, and can line up with you if you are in the air, nothing will save you.


</details>




**_Required:_**
**[geckolib 4.8.3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/8BmcQJ2H/versions/HVdLnQMI/geckolib-forge-1.20.1-4.8.3.jar?mr_download_reason=standalone)**
